title: See peoples killer wins survival wins and playtime
features: If you wanna see someones killer wins survival wins playtime etc. even though its hidden
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SETTINGS = {"HideKillerWins", "HidePlaytime", "HideSurvivorWins"}

local function apply(player)
	task.wait(0.2)
	local privacy = player:WaitForChild("PlayerData"):WaitForChild("Settings"):WaitForChild("Privacy")
	for _, name in ipairs(SETTINGS) do
		local v = privacy:FindFirstChild(name)
		if v and v.Value then v.Value = false end
	end
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(apply, p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.spawn(apply, p) end)
